summary: BBVA filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $2.05 billion three-tranche senior non-preferred debt offering: $750 million 5.609% fixed-rate notes due 2029, $1 billion 6.213% fixed-rate notes due 2036, and $300 million floating-rate notes due 2029. Interest on the fixed tranches is semiannual from May 2027; the floaters pay quarterly. Notes are direct, unsecured, unsubordinated obligations ranking junior to senior preferred and privileged claims but pari passu with other senior non-preferred debt. This is ordinary bank capital issuance, not a special situation; no equity terms or advisors named. Watch spread pricing and MREL eligibility.
